name: cognito-identity
description: Amazon Cognito Federated Identities Amazon Cognito Federated Identities is a web service that delivers scoped temporary credentials to mobile devices and other untrusted environments.

subcommands.name: create-identity-pool
subcommands.description: Creates a new identity pool.

subcommands.name: delete-identities
subcommands.description: Deletes identities from an identity pool.

subcommands.name: delete-identity-pool
subcommands.description: Deletes an identity pool.

subcommands.name: describe-identity
subcommands.description: Returns metadata related to the given identity, including when the identity was created and any associated linked logins.

subcommands.name: describe-identity-pool
subcommands.description: Gets details about a particular identity pool, including the pool name, ID description, creation date, and current number of users.

subcommands.name: get-credentials-for-identity
subcommands.description: Returns credentials for the provided identity ID.

subcommands.name: get-id
subcommands.description: Generates (or retrieves) IdentityID.

subcommands.name: get-identity-pool-roles
subcommands.description: Gets the roles for an identity pool.

subcommands.name: get-open-id-token
subcommands.description: Gets an OpenID token, using a known Cognito ID.

subcommands.name: get-open-id-token-for-developer-identity
subcommands.description: Registers (or retrieves) a Cognito IdentityId and an OpenID Connect token for a user authenticated by your backend authentication process.

subcommands.name: get-principal-tag-attribute-map
subcommands.description: Use GetPrincipalTagAttributeMap to list all mappings between PrincipalTags and user attributes.

subcommands.name: list-identities
subcommands.description: Lists the identities in an identity pool.

subcommands.name: list-identity-pools
subcommands.description: Lists all of the Cognito identity pools registered for your account.

subcommands.name: list-tags-for-resource
subcommands.description: Lists the tags that are assigned to an Amazon Cognito identity pool.

subcommands.name: lookup-developer-identity
subcommands.description: Retrieves the IdentityID associated with a DeveloperUserIdentifier or the list of DeveloperUserIdentifier values associated with an IdentityId for an existing identity.

subcommands.name: merge-developer-identities
subcommands.description: Merges two users having different IdentityIds, existing in the same identity pool, and identified by the same developer provider.

subcommands.name: set-identity-pool-roles
subcommands.description: Sets the roles for an identity pool.

subcommands.name: set-principal-tag-attribute-map
subcommands.description: You can use this operation to use default (username and clientID) attribute or custom attribute mappings.

subcommands.name: tag-resource
subcommands.description: Assigns a set of tags to the specified Amazon Cognito identity pool.

subcommands.name: unlink-developer-identity
subcommands.description: Unlinks a DeveloperUserIdentifier from an existing identity.

subcommands.name: unlink-identity
subcommands.description: Unlinks a federated identity from an existing account.

subcommands.name: untag-resource
subcommands.description: Removes the specified tags from the specified Amazon Cognito identity pool.

subcommands.name: update-identity-pool
subcommands.description: Updates the configuration of an identity pool.
